newsitem.title: LEBANON: Pro-Israelis arrest Lebanese doctor, Amnesty says.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Israelis arrest Lebanese doctor, Amnesty says.

text.p: A Lebanese surgeon was reported arrested by Israel's client militia in south Lebanon last week, the London-based humanitarian group Amnesty International said on Friday.

Amnesty said in a statement that Dr George Nakd was reported arrested on November 1 in his home village of Deir Mimas in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone by members of the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia and taken to Khiam prison.
"He is at risk of torture and prolonged detention without charge or trial," Amnesty said in the statement sent to Reuters.
More than 100 Lebanese are held by the SLA without trial at the hilltop Khiam jail and some 70 more are imprisoned in Israel.
AI called for Nakd's immediate release "if he is not to be promptly charged with a recognisably criminal offence and tried before a court which meets international standards for fair trials."

Nakd and his wife, who lived in the market town of Nabatiyeh just outside the Israeli-held zone, were given permits by the SLA to visit their family in Deir Mimas, Amnesty said. The wife's permit to go home was withdrawn by the SLA after Nakd's arrest, it added.
